title: PET 2 causal brain-to-body coupling proposal

already_implemented: Affect, mood and attention already enter VisualMindInput.

VisualPhysiology already changes pulse, shell_opacity, inner_density, translucency, flow_strength, flow_speed, core_glow, halo, iris_activity, eye_wetness, droplet_energy, droplet_spread and droplet_cohesion.
InteractionBodyActuation already changes bounded PBF compliance, cohesion, pulse, lean, recoil, resistance and cooperation.
ExpressionState already maps affect into pupils, brows, mouth, cheek glow and body glow.
why_the_user_sees_almost_no_change: The active material has material.override_genome_colors=true, so Genome primary/secondary/glow colors are ignored.
The active cinematic palette is almost black and its bloom_strength is 0.05, so small glow/physiology changes have poor contrast.
Body dimensions, roundness and persistent size are read from Genome and do not change during ordinary learning.
Core PBF viscosity, density compliance and surface tension come from a fixed LiquidTuningProfile; only small interaction deltas currently reach the solver.
Current metamorphosis mutates only a limited trait subset and does not mutate body_length, body_width, body_roundness, softness, viscosity, density compliance or surface tension.
BrainGenome learning mechanics are not body-state outputs; mapping learning_rate directly to color would be causally wrong.

architecture.owner: LifeCore remains authoritative for persistent cognition; a new BodyPhenotypeDirector derives bounded commands without mutating cognition.
architecture.pipeline: LifeState + VitaState + MorphDiagnostics + BodyFeedback -> EmbodimentSourceFrame -> BodyPhenotypeDirector -> FastPhenotypeActuation + DevelopmentalEvidence -> pet_body
authority_rules: Renderer and shader never mutate LifeState, VitaState or Genome.
Fast phenotype is recomputed from an immutable source snapshot and is not persisted as identity.
Persistent morphology is changed only by versioned DevelopmentState mutation records.
Structural solver fields never change while components are detached, returning or merging.
Base identity remains visible under every emotional state.

filtering.formula: y += (target-y) * (1-exp(-dt/tau)); choose tau_rise when target>y, tau_fall otherwise
filtering.hysteresis: A discrete visual mode may switch only when the new score exceeds the current score by 0.12 for at least 0.25 s.
filtering.identity_mix: final = identity_base + fast_delta; fast_delta must return to zero and never rewrite the base.

fast_couplings.meaning: Актывацыя выцягвае і адкрывае сілуэт, fatigue/stress яго кампактуюць; плошча амаль захоўваецца.
Бяспечны кантакт робіць цела мякчэйшым; пагроза — сабраным. Множыць profile value, не перапісвае яго.
Стомленае цела павольней пераліваецца; узбуджанае даўжэй мае follow-through.
Пры пагрозе маса збіраецца; у гульні і даследаванні крыху распускаецца.
Палёт становіцца бачнымі anticipation, lag, stretch і settle, але profile constants застаюцца базай.
Base hue заўсёды бачны; max hue shift 8 degrees. Колер не адзіны носьбіт эмоцыі.
fast_couplings.required_profile_change: Use genome-derived base or blend the authored palette with Genome. Keeping override_genome_colors=true without a genome blend prevents developmental color from appearing.

fast_couplings.meaning: Arousal у першую чаргу чытаецца праз рытм і emission, не праз замену hue.
Упэўненасць робіць ядро чытэльным; fatigue/uncertainty — больш празрыстым.
Плынь паказвае neural activity і curiosity без structural solver mutation.
Нейральная ўвага фіксуе позірк; microsaccades гаснуць падчас моцнай fixation.
Унутраны канфлікт бачны як bounded асіметрыя, не як выпадковы noise.
Нагрузка цела непасрэдна выклікае высілак, мяккую boundary і recoil.
Толькі 5-9% expressive breathing/stance. Рэальны persistent body size змяняецца асобна праз development.

eligibility: Mass conservation, remerge, topology and finite-state invariants pass.

evidence_channels.flight_mastery: EMA(successful landings + cursor chases + confidence - prediction_error)
evidence_channels.social_security: EMA(positive voluntary response + attachment + respected boundary - frustration)
evidence_channels.physical_resilience: EMA(successful stretch/remerge - emergency recovery - topology exhaustion)
evidence_channels.communication_mastery: EMA(vocal interaction reward + rhythm success - ignored bids)

slow_development.promotion: Create full before/after Genome record, run morphology extremes + body invariants + voice limits, then atomically promote or rollback.

implementation_files.work: Add serializable EmbodimentSourceFrame, FastPhenotypeActuation and DevelopmentalEvidence contracts.
Build one immutable source frame from Life/VITA/Morph diagnostics at 20 Hz.
Own BodyPhenotypeDirector state, filtering, hysteresis and causal trace.
Accept FastPhenotypeActuation beside VisualMindInput; do not let renderer read cognition directly.
Apply only safe runtime multipliers after profile sanitization; clamp around authored base.
Blend identity palette with bounded runtime HSV/emission/opacity deltas.
Accumulate slow evidence and extend metamorphosis to bounded coherent BodyGenome traits.
Show source signal, filtered target, clamp reason and effective phenotype value live.

acceptance_tests: Hold the same render seed and increase only arousal: flow/pulse/emission must rise; body area changes <2%.
Increase stress with arousal held constant: cohesion and compression rise; saturation falls; hue shift remains <=8 degrees.
Increase fatigue: viscosity/damping rise, flow and apparent size fall, blink slows.
Switch active material override on/off: Genome palette remains identifiable in both modes.
Run 10 simulated days with one fixed evidence trace twice: final Genome hash and phenotype trace match.
A single high-stress event never changes persistent morphology.
No fast channel changes particle_count, fixed_hz, solver iterations, topology limits or loudness cap.
Detached/returning components preserve desktop-frame inertia while the body root moves.
Every target logs source terms, raw target, filtered value, clamp and persistence class.
